coordinated_research_area_sqm.formula: announced area from qualification pre-announcement (43.6 km2); provisional polygon recalculation uses EPSG:4548 and yields 43,609,232.6 sqm, within tolerance

site_area_sqm.formula: polygon_area(submitted provisional site boundary) in EPSG:4548; announced value 11,400,000 sqm, provisional recalculation yields 11,412,825.386 sqm, within tolerance

key_detailed_design_area_sqm.formula: sum of three announced key-area areas: zhongzhiyuan 1,921,000 + origin community 1,043,000 + dazhongsi 720,000 = 3,684,000 sqm; provisional MultiPolygon recalculation in EPSG:4548 yields 3,692,893.0 sqm, within tolerance

zhongzhiyuan_area_sqm.formula: announced key-area area (192.1 ha); provisional polygon recalculation in EPSG:4548 yields 1,929,201.9 sqm

beijing_ai_origin_community_area_sqm.formula: announced key-area area (104.3 ha); provisional polygon recalculation in EPSG:4548 yields 1,043,236.9 sqm

dazhongsi_area_sqm.formula: announced key-area area (72.0 ha); provisional polygon recalculation in EPSG:4548 yields 720,454.2 sqm

key_area_count.formula: count(KEY_AREA features with area_id in {zhongzhiyuan_ai_acceleration_area, beijing_ai_origin_community, dazhongsi_ai_industry_cluster})

ai_scenario_card_count.formula: count of AI scenario cards authored in proposal.md chapter 6 (>= 10 required, including >= 3 industry test/validation scenarios)

industry_test_scenario_count.formula: count of AI industry test/validation scenario cards in proposal.md chapter 6 (>= 3 required)

user_persona_count.formula: count of user personas authored in proposal.md chapter 6 (>= 5 required)

ai_landmark_count.formula: count of AI pilgrimage landmarks / honor-display nodes in proposal.md chapter 9 (>= 3 required)

global_case_count.formula: count of global AI innovation ecosystem cases in proposal.md chapter 3 (5-8 required), each with source + non-transferability boundary statement

compliance_coverage.formula: count of requirements covered in compliance_matrix.json (17 official + 6 agent tasks, all mandatory)

green_ratio.formula: green_space_area_sqm / site_area_sqm in EPSG:4548 (design-derived from provisional green_space layer; not a statutory regulatory ratio)

public_space_ratio.formula: public_space_area_sqm / site_area_sqm in EPSG:4548 (design-derived from provisional public_space layer; not a statutory regulatory ratio)

floor_area_ratio.formula: total_floor_area_sqm / site_area_sqm; pending official regulatory detailed-planning controls
floor_area_ratio.reason: Floor-area ratio is a statutory regulatory-planning indicator. No official regulatory detailed-planning control table or cleared attachment is present in the repository, so no value can be asserted without fabricating official certainty.

building_height_m.formula: statutory maximum building height from regulatory detailed planning; pending official controls
building_height_m.reason: Building height is a statutory regulatory-planning indicator. No official regulatory detailed-planning control table or cleared attachment is present in the repository.

building_density.formula: building_footprint_area_sqm / site_area_sqm; pending official regulatory detailed-planning controls
building_density.reason: Building density is a statutory regulatory-planning indicator. No official regulatory detailed-planning control table or cleared attachment is present in the repository.

total_floor_area_sqm.formula: sum(building_footprint * conceptual_floors); pending official FAR / height / parcel controls
total_floor_area_sqm.reason: Total floor area depends on statutory FAR and height controls, neither of which is present in the repository. Any figure would be a fabricated official conclusion.

setback_m.formula: statutory setback from regulatory detailed planning; pending official controls
setback_m.reason: Setback is a statutory regulatory-planning indicator. No official regulatory detailed-planning control table or cleared attachment is present in the repository.

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: sum(polygon_area(12 building footprints)) in EPSG:4548 = 153647.821 sqm (design-derived; statutory total floor area depends on FAR/height controls which are unknown)
